doc.title: Karolina Strassmayer interviewed by Monk Rowe, May 25, 2023

title: Being the first woman in the WDR Big Band
summary: Her 2004 vote-based hiring drew sensationalist media interest in what it was like to be the only woman.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: Was there a media announcement about the first girl in the WDR big band?

Yes. It was quite a big — I don’t want to say uproar — but there was a lot of media interest because none of the German radio or European radio big band had a female member at the time. This was 2004 when I joined. And yes, it was kind of strange. It was a little bit similar to I don’t know if you remember that in the 90s I think it was when the Vienna Philharmonic began accepting women because they were pressured. There were even articles in the New York Times and it was, in the WDR this was not the case, it just so happened that I joined. And the decision was made by all the band members. This was not a decision — this is how we fill all the positions. It’s really a vote of all the band members. It’s not a decision of the management or of the broadcast company or anything like that. But it was kind of strange for me at first because there was all this interest, also womens’ magazines and newspapers, and they all just wanted to know what is it like to be the only woman in the WDR Big Band. And nobody asked me about my musical background you know they all just wanted to know are they nice to you or are you allowed to play solos? Do they make jokes or do they grope you? It was quite sensationalist, depending on the publications. And of course that died down after a while and it became normal and all of that. But I really began to really loathe that question, like oh what is it like to be the only woman and I really never wanted to deal with that because I thought please just let me play music. I am a person who plays music. But I realized over time that it is something unusual, it is something that interests people
